03 / Why Sequence?

Every piece
has its place.

A sequence is more than a single shot. It’s a collection of individual elements, intentionally arranged to create something complete.

That’s how we approach creative work. Every frame, sound, detail, and idea has a role. Put together with intention, it becomes something worth watching.
